cwe_732.title: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
cwe_732.summary: A product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows unintended actors to read or modify it.

ms_icacls.title: icacls command
ms_icacls.summary: Displays or modifies discretionary access control lists on specified files, including inherited ACEs.

openssh_windows_acl.title: Security protection of various files in Win32-OpenSSH
openssh_windows_acl.summary: administrators_authorized_keys is silently ignored unless the ACL is limited to SYSTEM and Administrators.

ms_ace_order.title: Order of ACEs in a DACL
ms_ace_order.summary: Canonical order is explicit deny, explicit allow, inherited deny, inherited allow. Inherited deny does not override explicit allow.
